title: Listen up, Crumbums! Your King is here.
author: simonne
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/45164767/40a0a47432b4e8c857d40152295f1551702c1012.png[/img]

Out of the sewers and into the streets, the rightful King of the Rats is here at last. Rodent-hating citizens of Manhattan won't be prepared to see his [i]Scrap Grenade[/i] bouncing down Broadway, nor for his [i]Swarm of Rats[/i] biting at their heels. By donning his [i]Royal Pestments[/i], the Rat King shakes off incoming damage, allowing him to bravely lead the charge into battle. His loyal subjects will feel awed and inspired when they see the great [i]Banner of Rattania[/i] waving in the middle of combat, and those who oppose him will rue the day they ever thought they could overthrow the king. - [i]"Oh the rats are taking over, baby!"[/i]

The Rat King is available to play now! Have a great weekend and keep those votes coming, as our next hero will be joining us on Tuesday at 2pm PDT. We'll see you then!
